home.title: Jomni Blommor, flower shop on Södermalm in Stockholm
home.description: Bouquets, wedding flowers, funeral flowers and flowers for events. Hand-tied at Jomni Blommor on Hornsgatan, Södermalm, Stockholm.
home.hero.heading: Flowers tied by hand, for big days and small ones
home.services.heading: What we do
home.services.intro: From a Friday bouquet to the flowers at your wedding. Tell us what you need and we will help.
home.about.heading: About the shop
home.about.body: This is where we tell the story of Jomni Blommor: who ties the flowers, how long the shop has been here and what makes it special.
home.about.alt: Sample image: a florist tying a bouquet at the workbench in the shop.
home.contact.heading: Order flowers
home.contact.body: Tell us what you would like, when, and who it is for. We will get back to you to confirm. You are also welcome to drop by the shop.
